standard_prerequisites.name: Nakayama's lemma for a local ring, applied to the stalk of a free module of rank one
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 4604-4606 as a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that a section not lying in the maximal ideal times the module is a basis of the stalk.

core_obligations: Local basis: at a point of the locus the proof uses the triviality of the tensor product of the module with its inverse to see that both stalks are free of rank one, and Nakayama's lemma to conclude that the given section is a basis of the stalk (proof lines 4595-4606)

Find a neighbourhood: the complementary basis element of the inverse is represented by a section over an open neighbourhood on which the pairing of the two sections maps to one, and on that neighbourhood the given section generates every stalk, so the neighbourhood is contained in the locus (proof lines 4607-4614)

Openness and the inverse section: this proves that the locus is open, and the local sections constructed are unique, so they glue to the required section of the inverse over the locus (proof lines 4615-4617)
proof_roadmap: 对 x ∈ X_s，由 L ⊗ L^{-1} ≅ O_X 与两个茎都是秩 1 自由模，用 Nakayama 引理得 s_x 是 L_x 的一组基，故存在 (L^{-1})_x 的基元素 t_x 使 s_x ⊗ t_x ↦ 1。
取邻域 U 使 t_x 来自截面 t 且 s ⊗ t ↦ 1；则 U 上 s 处处生成茎，故 U ⊂ X_s，得开性；t 唯一故可粘接成 X_s 上 L^{-1} 的截面 s'。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement proves that for an invertible module on a ringed space with local local rings the nonvanishing locus of a section is open, that the section trivialises the module there, and that it admits an inverse section over the locus (author lemma at source lines 4576-4592, label lemma-s-open). The proof (source lines 4594-4618) uses the pairing with the inverse module and Nakayama's lemma to show that the section is a basis of the stalk at a point of the locus, then finds a neighbourhood on which the complementary basis element is represented by a section and on which the pairing is one, which shows that the neighbourhood lies in the locus and that the local inverse sections glue (proof lines 4595-4617). The Nakayama step and the gluing of the local inverse sections are the content. H2.
